timeline.title: EXAMPLE: Project initialized from AI Guidance baseline.
timeline.detail: What happened and why it matters for future agents.

timeline.title: Enforcement layer + auto KPI-snapshot added.
timeline.detail: Git hooks (pre-commit validate, pre-push gate on v* tags), CI (state-validation, lighthouse-ci, kpi-snapshot), and scripts (validate_state, check_release_gate, snapshot_kpis) make state integrity and release gates machine-enforced. KPI snapshots, memory entries, and status resets now run automatically on release tags. Resolved debt-001.

timeline.title: Reference metric fetcher wired into the snapshot pipeline.
timeline.detail: scripts/fetch_metrics.py (+ fetch_metrics.sh wrapper) reads kpis.json and queries each KPI's instrumentation.source — Amplitude (event segmentation), Supabase (PostgREST count), CrUX (field p75). Wired into kpi-snapshot.yml before the snapshot step. Unconfigured/erroring sources are omitted and carried forward, so the release pipeline is now fully turnkey without ever blocking on metric retrieval. Seed kpis.json now uses concrete sources + fetch config.
